Exceptional Strength.description: The character has *NUM* natural exceptional Strength(s). Exceptionals grant a static bonus to their associated Attribute and may be stressed for powerful effects...

ability.name: Stress Exceptional Strength
ability.description: The character rolls the maximum number on their choice of 3 damage dice this turn.  This ability expends the exceptional, only to return during the next long rest

ability.name: Stress Exceptional Agility

ability.name: Stress Exceptional Health
